**Which claim are you attacking?**
(One of the six on https://igrm.in/break.html, or state your own.)

**Your method**
(Code, query, diff, or dated episode list — enough for us to rerun it.
`scripts/reproduce.sh --use-cache` runs in ~5 minutes with no credentials.)

**Your result**
(What you found, with numbers.)

**What would change your mind?**
(Optional, but it's the standard we hold ourselves to.)
